content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new here and recently started working with [product_name] controllers. I'm facing two issues while programming: 1. I have three analog inputs and need to extract the maximum value among them (for instance, CO2 sensors: AI1-500ppm, AI2-550ppm, AI3-800ppm, so the highest value is AI3-800ppm). 2. I need help creating linear control logic, such as mapping an analog input range to an analog output range (example: 0-10V input to 0-10V output, or scaling 2-5V input to 5-10V output in a linear fashion). Any advice would be appreciated. Thank you. [user_name]

Dear [user_name], I recommend reviewing the following resources and a section in the manual for [product_name]: • [product_name] library – Functions for analog value processing and communication • Analog multiplexer Best regards.

analysis.insight_summary: A user requests assistance with two analog signal processing tasks on [product_name] controllers: determining the maximum value among multiple inputs and applying custom linear signal mapping (input-to-output scaling). Responses point to manuals and libraries for analog functions, suggesting that relevant documentation may be difficult for users to find when solving practical programming issues.
